						has_law = law_type:law_dedicated_police
						has_law = law_type:law_militarized_police
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_bad_police"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_land_tax"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_free_trade
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					leader = {
						law_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_free_trade
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_anti_free_trade"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_peasant_levies"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					}
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "bpm_from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = owner.py:agrarian_party
					}
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:agrarian_party
						owner = {
							NOT = {
								any_interest_group = {
									OR = {
										is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
										AND = {
											bpm_ig_is_rural_institutional = yes
											leader = {
												OR = {
													bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
													bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes
													AND = {
														has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
														prev = {
															ig_approval <= -4
														}
													}
												}
											}
										}
									}
									is_member_of_party = owner.py:agrarian_party
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "from_no_progressive_agrarians_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_local_police
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_privatized_police
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_bad_police"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire
				}
				NOR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_anti_free_trade"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sikh_moralist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_socialist
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_peasant_levies"
			}
		}
	}
}

	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"

					is_party_type = anarchist_party

			add = {

			}

					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists

				}
				OR = {

					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_anarchists_in_council_republic"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					exists = ig:ig_anarchists
				}
				owner = {
					ig:ig_anarchists ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "powerful_anarchists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
					ruler = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_vanguard_anarchy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							bpm_ig_is_marginal = no
							leader = {
								bpm_leader_is_communist = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_no_communists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes

	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/communists.dds"
	}
	unlocking_technologies = {
		socialism
	}
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = {
			bpm_is_party_banned = {
				PARTY = communist_party
			}
		}
		owner = {
			any_interest_group = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				bpm_ig_is_marginal = no
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				bpm_ig_is_right_wing = no
				bpm_ig_is_market_liberal = no
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_right_wing = no
				}
			}
			leader = {
				bpm_leader_is_radical_socialist = yes
			}
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			bpm_ig_is_upper_institutional = no
			NOT = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
		}
		leader ?= {
			NOR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
				character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_clerical_fascist
			}
		}
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -2
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_communist
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_communist
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = communist_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_still_united"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_reformist_socialist = yes
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "bpm_disunited_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes
					bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "bpm_from_socialist_leader"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_party_socialist_leader"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 12
				desc = "bpm_from_party_socialist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "bpm_from_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_illegal_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_communist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "bpm_from_revsoc"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_communist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_revsoc"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_liberal_leader"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_revsoc"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = no
				bpm_leader_is_proletarian_socialist = no
				OR = {
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes
					}
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes
					}
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_socdem_communism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = first_intl_disunited_var
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_anarchist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_anarchist_anti_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_anarchist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -60
				desc = "bpm_anarchist_want_their_own_party_in_council_republic"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_in_government = yes
							bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_republican_liberal = yes
					}
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_free_trade
				}
				NOT = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_laissez_faire
				}
				NOT = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
						has_law = law_type:law_no_social_security
					}
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_pre_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_sexist = no
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_cit_liberal_nationalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_cit_immigrant_nationalist
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_ethnostate
						has_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						has_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anti_discrimination"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_revolutionist_socialists
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = owner.py:communist_party
					}
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:communist_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_revolutionist_socialists ?= {
								NOT = {
									is_member_of_party = owner.py:communist_party
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "from_no_communists_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_socialist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade
				}
				NOR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_free_trade"
			}
		}
	}
}

		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		always = no
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_military
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_military
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = owner.py:military_party
					}
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:military_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_armed_forces = {
								NOT = {
									is_member_of_party = owner.py:military_party
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_no_army_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_strong_military"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_jingoist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_paternalist_ideology = yes
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic
				}
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					has_law = law_type:law_no_police
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_police"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sikh_moralist
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
						}
					}
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_socialist
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_peasant_levies"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_social_democrat
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_loyalist
				}
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
						has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation
						has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_graduated_taxation"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_meritocratic
					AND = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_loyalist
						owner = {
							NOT = {
								has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
							}
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
						has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_proportional_or_per_capita_tax"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
	}
}

	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/radical.dds"

	unlocking_technologies = {
		egalitarianism
	}
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = {
			bpm_is_party_banned = {
				PARTY = radical_party
			}
		}
		AND = {
			bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = no
			bpm_ig_is_moderate_conservative = no
		}
		leader = {
			bpm_leader_is_right_wing = no
		}
		bpm_ig_is_anarchist = no
		leader = {
			bpm_leader_is_anarchist = no
		}
		leader ?= {
			NOT = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
				character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_clerical_fascist
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_socialist
			}
		}
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -2
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_radical
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_radical
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = radical_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes
					}
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_radical_ig"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_radical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
				}
				bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							leader = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							}
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_weak_liberals_radical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "bpm_disunited_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_variable = first_intl_disunited_var
					has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
					has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_anarchist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_anarchist_anti_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_proletarian"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
						AND = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
							prev = {
								ig_approval <= -8
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_progressives_radical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_republican_liberal = yes
					}
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_modern_agrarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_agrarian_socialist
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
						has_law = law_type:law_debt_slavery
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_particularism_cares_about_laws"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_luddite
				}
				owner = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_anti_industrialization"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_voting_franchise = no
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_radical_democrat
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_moderate_democrat
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_no_democracy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_radical_democrat
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_no_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = radicals_renamed_var
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_pro_public_welfare = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = no
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_progressivism_with_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
						has_law = law_type:law_censorship
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_censorship
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_national_guard
						has_law = law_type:law_secret_police
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_bad_home_affairs
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
						has_law = law_type:law_no_social_security
						has_law = law_type:law_unregulated_work_time
						has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts
					}
					NOR = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
						has_global_variable = first_intl_chain_complete_var
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_pre_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_feminist = yes
				owner = {
					bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_socialist = no
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sta_minimal_state
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sta_decentralized_state
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sta_federated_state
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_descentralism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_despotic_utopian
					}
					AND = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
						owner = {
							has_variable = patino_paraguay_var
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 30
				desc = "from_despotic_utopian"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_tridemism
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "bpm_tridemist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					THIS = c:JAP
					has_variable = bpm_imperial_democracy
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 21
				desc = "bpm_from_jap_liberals"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						THIS = c:JAP
					}
					is_subject = yes
					NOR = {
						is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union
						is_subject_type = subject_type_tributary
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 21
				desc = "bpm_independence_radicals"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
				leader = {
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_monarchist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = owner.py:radical_party

					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:radical_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_radicals ?= {
								NOT = {
									is_member_of_party = owner.py:radical_party
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "from_no_radicals_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = patino_paraguay_var
						has_variable = francocracia_paraguay_var
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				bpm_ig_is_anti_democratic = no
				leader = {
					NOT = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_despotic_utopian
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_anti_despotism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					owner = c:USA
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						has_variable = radical_party_leader
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 100
					desc = "bpm_historical_leader"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					leader = {
						has_variable = anti_radical_party_leader
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -100
					desc = "bpm_historical_leader"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						has_variable = bpm_july_monarchy
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
							is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 100
						desc = "bpm_from_july_monarchy"
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOT = {
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						}
						has_variable = bpm_fra_second_republic
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -50
					desc = "bpm_from_liberal_coalition"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_gendarmerie
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = from_bad_home_affairs
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 1
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = labor_movement
				}
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_socialist
				}
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_early_trade_unions"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
							}
						}
					}
					add = 10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					add = 5
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_weighted_universal_voting
						}
					}
					add = 2.5
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
				ig_clout <= 0.05
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
					}
					NOR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
					has_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
					OR = {
						bpm_secularist_popularity >= 0.2
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_variable = bpm_old_new_wine_christian_democrat_win_variable
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_catholic_political_involment"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "bpm_from_common_interests"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_rel_pragmatic_moralist
			}
			add = {
				value = 100
				desc = "bpm_from_being_oppresed"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						exists = owner.py:religious_party
					}
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:religious_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_christian_democrats ?= {
								NOT = {
									is_member_of_party = owner.py:religious_party
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_christdems_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_clerical_fascist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_devout_other"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_ecclesiarchy
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 9999
				desc = "from_theocracy"
			}
		}
	}
}

					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_no_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							bpm_ig_is_reformist_socialist = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_weak_liberals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					AND = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_powerful = yes
							OR = {
								leader = {
									bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes
								}
								bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							any_interest_group = {
								is_powerful = yes
								bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_weak_liberals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_progressivism_sd
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
				}
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = from_marked_liberal_sd
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 150
				desc = "from_trade_union_interests_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_in_government = yes
							bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
							is_powerful = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_republican_liberal = yes
					}
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_free_trade
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_income_tax
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
						has_law = law_type:law_no_social_security
					}
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_pre_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_sexist = no
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = no
				bpm_ig_is_socialist_trade_unions = no
				owner = {
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							exists = py:social_democrat_party
						}
						py:social_democrat_party = {
							NOT = {
								any_member = {
									OR = {
										bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = yes
										bpm_ig_is_socialist_trade_unions = yes
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_variable = bpm_fra_second_republic
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "bpm_no_socdems_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = c:GBR
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_socialists
						leader = {
							bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = yes
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_global_variable = first_intl_chain_complete_var
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "bpm_from_english_early_socialists"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = c:FRA
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_socialists
						is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						leader = {
							bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = yes
						}
					}
					owner = {
						has_variable = bpm_fra_second_republic
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "bpm_from_french_early_socialists"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_magnatial
					ig_has_carlist_ideology = yes
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade
				}
				NOT = {
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_free_trade"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire
				}
				NOT = {
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarcho_liberal
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
	}
}
